monogr.title: Inter-list Diversity Across Repetitions. The figure illustrates the inter-list Diversity@10

This figure shows the distribution of movies recommended by LLMs based on their release years. The results are categorized by model size and prompting strategies. The x-axis represents the year of release, spanning from 1950 to 2025, while the y-axis indicates the fraction of movies released each year. The data, aggregated in 5-year-spans, exhibits a noticeable increase in movie releases over time
